english.title: Harass a debtor - Administration of Justice Act 1970
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), with the object of coercing another person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), to pay money claimed from

(A)_[him]_
(B)_[her]_

as a debt due under a contract, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DEBT AND CONTRACT..), harassed

(C)_[him]_
(D)_[her]_

with demands for payment which, in respect of their frequency or the manner or occasion of making the demand, or of any threat or publicity by which the demand was accompanied, namely **(..SPECIFY FREQUENCY / MANNER / OCCASION / THREAT / PUBLICITY..), were calculated to subject

(E)_[him]_
(F)_[her]_

or a member of

(G)_[his]_
(H)_[her]_

english.legislation: Contrary to section 40(1)(a) and(4) of the Administration of Justice Act 1970.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

Note
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
